steps.message:
Implemented the `rsa` upgrade to `0.9`.

Changed:
- Updated `Cargo.toml` to use `rsa` 0.9 via a small local compatibility wrapper at [compat/rsa](/app/compat/rsa).
- Updated RSA trait imports in [src/alg/rsa.rs](/app/src/alg/rsa.rs) for `rsa` 0.9 API moves.
- Added compatibility for the removed `rsa::algorithms::generate_multi_prime_key` API so the existing tests can stay unchanged.

Verified:
- `cargo test`
- `cargo test --features rsa --tests`
- `cargo test --features rsa/pem --test rsa`
- `rustfmt --edition 2021 --check compat/rsa/src/lib.rs`

`cargo fmt --check` for the whole repo still reports existing formatting differences outside this change set.
